cases.sentence: Из лагеря Саула пришел ___ в разорванной одежде.
cases.explain: Subject of the verb 'пришел' requires nominative case.

cases.sentence: Придя к ___, он поклонился ему до земли.
Человек сказал о ___, который был у Саула.
cases.explain: Preposition 'о' with accusative case for things that are the object of speech.

cases.sentence: Давид вернулся, победив ___ за два дня.
cases.explain: Direct object of the perfective verb 'победить' requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Саул опирался на свое ___ когда Давид его увидел.
cases.explain: Verb 'опираться' (to lean on) governs instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Браслет был с ___ Саула на руке.

cases.explain: Preposition 'на' with locative (prepositional) case for location.

cases.sentence: Все люди плакали о ___, который был мертв.
cases.explain: Preposition 'о' with locative (prepositional) case in the phrase 'о + person'.

reading.ru: После смерти Саула Давид вернулся, победив Амаликитян, и пробыл в Циклаге два дня.
reading.question: What did David do after the death of Saul?
options: He defeated the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag for two days
He became king immediately over all Israel
He fled to the mountains to hide from enemies
He went to Jerusalem to build a temple
reading.correct: He defeated the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag for two days
reading.explain: The text states David returned from defeating the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag for two days.

reading.ru: Придя к Давиду, он поклонился ему до земли.
reading.question: How did the man from Saul's camp greet David?
options: He challenged David to a duel
reading.explain: The text says 'поклонился ему до земли' meaning he bowed to the ground.

reading.ru: Человек сказал, 'Я спасся из лагеря израилетян'.
reading.question: Where did the messenger escape from?
options: From the camp of the Jebusites
From the camp of the Israelites
reading.correct: From the camp of the Israelites
reading.explain: The man explicitly states 'из лагеря израилетян' (from the camp of the Israelites).

reading.ru: Он сказал юноше, который принес ему это известие: 'Откуда ты знаешь, что Саул и его сын Ионафан мертвы?'
reading.question: What did David ask the young man about?
options: How he knew about Saul and Jonathan's death
What news he brought from Jerusalem
reading.correct: How he knew about Saul and Jonathan's death
reading.explain: David questions how the young man knows that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.

reading.ru: Юноша ответил: 'Я случайно оказался на горе Гельбоа, и там был Саул, который опирался на свое копье.'
reading.question: What was Saul doing when the young man found him on Mount Gilboa?
options: He was running from his enemies
He was leaning on his spear
He was speaking with his generals
reading.correct: He was leaning on his spear
reading.explain: The text states 'Саул, который опирался на свое копье' (Saul was leaning on his spear).

reading.ru: Затем Давид и все, кто был с ним, разорвали на себе одежду и плакали до вечера о Сауле и его сыне Иоаннафане.
reading.question: How did David and his people mourn Saul and Jonathan?
options: They went to war against the Philistines
They tore their clothes, wept, and mourned until evening
They built a monument in their honor
reading.correct: They tore their clothes, wept, and mourned until evening
reading.explain: The text describes that David and his people 'разорвали на себе одежду' (tore their clothes) and 'плакали до вечера' (wept until evening).
